title: Kiritani Haruka — Hope Delivered〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Voice
rows.Line: Thanks for letting me take a bath first, Mom. It's all yours now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... We weren't assigned any homework today, so...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I'm supposed to check over that magazine article. In that case, I'll clean up a little and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hm...?
*Yawn...*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess my body hasn't had much time to recover. I have been pretty busy lately.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Saito has also been asking whether or not I should be taking on so much work.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But the schedule she came up with afterwards seemed doable...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (On the other hand, I wanted to accept as many offers as I could to make the most of the wave we caught after Mr. Arimura's show aired.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I am glad that I went for it. Also, today was a pretty good checkpoint too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Still...
*Yawn...*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I should get some sleep...
I can just wake up early tomorrow to check over that article.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For now, let's stretch...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Some background music would be nice.
Where did I put my phone...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, today's when...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, the new one's up.
I'll listen to this today...

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
<Hello, listeners!
It's time for this week's “Smiling News Bulletin”♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I can't help but smile when I hear her voice...)

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: <To start, I have an important announcement to make.>

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: <I'll be holding another mini-concert at our usual mall this Sunday!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Wow, another one?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But she mentioned that she'd be doing another mini-concert previously. Is she talking about the same one...?)

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: <Also, this one's going to be a charity event, so I'll be performing lots of songs by different artists that are popular right now alongside my own!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Nope, it's a different one...
She's basically doing one every other week now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(That's pretty incredible.
On top of performing at welfare facilities and kindergartens, now she's putting on charity concerts...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She's doing everything she can in order to spread hope to others.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's so great...
And it should be a fun concert since she'll be performing a lot of different songs.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, wait...
I forgot that I need to stretch.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll leave my phone somewhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: <So, to give you a little taste of what my next concert's going to be like, let's play this tune. Hit it♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, this song...!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Let's dance on stage together!
How about it?!

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: B-But... I don't know how...

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
No problem!
We'll do something simple! I'm sure you'll get it in no time, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: So, let's dance!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: Ready...? Go!

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh... I'm in perfect sync with the music...)

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Oh, look at her. That's adorable. She's dancing like there's no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Girlfriend
rows.Line:
Hey, check out that girl!
She's so little, but an amazing dancer!

rows.Speaker: Boyfriend
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah, she is.
I can't help but smile while watching her.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (They all like the way I'm dancing...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (Right now? I'm smiling...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
(Oh, I guess I am...
I mean, that nice lady, the others... They're all sparkling...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (This is so much fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
<I hope you enjoyed that.
During the show, I plan on showing you all a simple dance routine that goes with it♪>

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: <Hehe. Actually, some of you may already know how to do it from previous concerts!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The dance routine for this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Kick and step and...
Turn and tilt your head...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I still seem to remember it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I was supposed to be stretching before I go to bed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm going to do my stretches and do my best again tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (So that I can spread hope to lots of people like the way she has.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...
